explication: ONNX Runtime is a cross-platform inference and training engine with language bindings and hardware execution-provider support. The primary workflow is to load an ONNX model, prepare its graph, execute it through a selected provider, and return outputs. Training and higher-level applications are distinct branches. The README establishes the product capabilities; sampled source supports selected binding, training-pipeline, and application details, so uncertain internal wiring is omitted.
